name: FullHouse Bar
description: FullHouse Bar is a lively karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and great security. It offers a fun environment with a focus on safety, featuring security guards present during hours and a well-lit outside smoking area. The venue is praised for its friendly staff, quality food, and vibrant vibe, making it a popular spot for karaoke enthusiasts seeking a secure and enjoyable experience. The place stands out for its community feel and dedication to customer safety, ensuring a memorable night out.
